image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates surrounded by a textured, spiny girdle. The surrounding environment includes encrusted rocks and other small marine organisms.
